e.title: VA Valuation with SHAP
e.summary: 变额年金组合估值论文代码：SHAP 代表性抽样加速组合估值（XAI 方法）
e.body: VA_valuation_with_SHAP 是论文《Variable annuity portfolio valuation with SHapley Additive exPlanations》的代码与笔记本：用 SHAP 做代表性抽样（representative sampling），加速变额年金（VA）组合估值——把全组合模拟缩到代表性子集，同时保持估值精度。对 RIAA：XAI（SHAP）在精算估值性能优化上的应用范例——与 [[credibility-gated-xai]]（准备金 XAI）、[[dav-xai-notebooks]]（DAV XAI 教程）同属精算 XAI 谱系。关联 [[actuarial-pricing]]、[[lifecontingencies]]、[[open-source-economic-model]]。
e.verified_note: raw README 核实：变额年金组合估值 SHAP 代表性抽样论文代码（UNSW），UNSW Actuarial Software Directory 收录
e.summary_en: Paper code for variable-annuity portfolio valuation with SHAP-based representative sampling (XAI method for accelerating valuation)
e.summary_hk: 變額年金組合估值論文代碼：SHAP 代表性抽樣加速組合估值（XAI 方法）
e.body_en: VA_valuation_with_SHAP is the code and notebooks of the paper 'Variable annuity portfolio valuation with SHapley Additive exPlanations': using SHAP-based representative sampling to accelerate variable-annuity (VA) portfolio valuation — reducing full-portfolio simulation to a representative subset while preserving valuation accuracy. For RIAA: an application example of XAI (SHAP) for actuarial valuation-performance optimization — joining [[credibility-gated-xai]] (reserving XAI) and [[dav-xai-notebooks]] (DAV XAI tutorials) in the actuarial-XAI spectrum. Related: [[actuarial-pricing]], [[lifecontingencies]], [[open-source-economic-model]].
e.body_hk: VA_valuation_with_SHAP 是論文《Variable annuity portfolio valuation with SHapley Additive exPlanations》的代碼與筆記本：用 SHAP 做代表性抽樣（representative sampling），加速變額年金（VA）組合估值——把全組合模擬縮到代表性子集，同時保持估值精度。對 RIAA：XAI（SHAP）在精算估值性能優化上的應用範例——與 [[credibility-gated-xai]]（準備金 XAI）、[[dav-xai-notebooks]]（DAV XAI 教程）同屬精算 XAI 譜系。關聯 [[actuarial-pricing]]、[[lifecontingencies]]、[[open-source-economic-model]]。
